note: The RTMLink app commit on `main` (production, live at rtmlink.com) that the help center has been TRIAGED up to. The Maintainer (meta/agents/maintainer.md) advances this inside its one rolling PR, after diffing `main` forward from here and flagging affected articles — it means 'every change up to here has been triaged into the registry as stale/todo', NOT 'every article is reconciled'. Per-article reconciliation is tracked separately by each article's `last_reviewed_commit`, which the Maintainer advances when it writes. Because the PR is rolling (each run re-diffs from the last MERGED value here), the value in an open PR is provisional until that PR merges. ALWAYS diff from origin/main, never `git rev-parse HEAD` (the app working tree is often an unmerged feature branch). Advance this only to a merged `main` commit, together with that window's flags.
